title: Classic Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful beef stew cooked with vegetables, bacon, and Guinness, perfect for a comforting meal.

ingredients.item: Half a package of chopped bacon

steps: Brown the stew meat in a Dutch oven in batches until beautifully browned. Remove and set aside.
Reduce the heat, add a little olive oil, and sauté the diced onions and minced garlic until softened.
Add chopped bacon and cook until browned.
Stir in chopped carrots and celery, cooking for a short while.
Add flour and cook for about a minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in tomato paste, chicken broth, and Guinness beer. Mix well.
Return the browned meat to the pot with its juices.
Ensure the meat is covered with liquid, bring to a simmer, then cover with a lid.
Cook for 2 hours with the lid on, then remove the lid and cook for an additional 30 to 40 minutes.
